title: Joseph's Hidden Years Playbook
hook: No movement? You might be in Joseph's hidden years.
script: No movement? You might be in Joseph's hidden years. In Genesis, Joseph didn't see doors swing open for years, but God was shaping him. Here's the playbook. Steward the small: in Potiphar's house he handled chores like they mattered to heaven. Guard your heart: betrayed, forgotten, yet he refused bitterness. Serve where you stand: in prison he used his gift to lift others. Do these three today: tidy one task, bless one enemy in prayer, help one person with your skill. Hidden years aren't wasted. They're training. God promotes prepared hearts.

title: When God Feels Silent: Guard Your Heart
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: If God feels silent right now, watch this. Joseph knew that silence. Years of betrayal and false accusation, and still no rescue. How did he not rot inside? He guarded his heart. Name the wound, hand it to God, then choose blessing over blame. Try this prayer: Lord, You see me. I release this hurt to You. Make me useful today. Then act on it. Send encouragement to someone, even from your own prison. Soft hearts hear God sooner. Bitterness blocks it. Guard your heart, and let God handle the timeline.

title: A Weekly Rhythm for the Waiting Season
hook: If you're tired of waiting on God, listen to this.
script: If you're tired of waiting on God, listen to this. Joseph's rise looked sudden, but his faithfulness was daily. Build a hidden-years rhythm. Pray-plan once a week: Lord, what's my next faithful step? Then write two small actions you can control. Micro-serve each day: help one person with what you have. Review every week: where did I see grace, where did I grow? Make a simple tracker with three checks: steward small, guard heart, serve where you stand. When nothing changes outside, God is changing you inside. And prepared hearts meet open doors.
